Definition: 'Thou must not destroy'; probably the opening words to a popular song
BiblicalUsage: The words stand at the head of four psalms — To the chief Musician, Altaschith — meaning Destroy thou not. It is probably the opening line of a well-known song, and David's psalms borrow its tune: one written in the cave fleeing Saul, one against unjust judges, one against Saul's watchmen, and one of thanksgiving for God's judgment.
TheologicalSignificance: A tune title carries no doctrine of its own; its weight is the plea inside it, do not destroy, and the four psalms underneath it that show God hearing, judging, and saving.
